        <p class="project-card-desc">A review of theory, exposure measures, and evidence on generative AI&#x27;s labour-market effects — productivity gains are sizable but context-dependent, concentrated in high-wage occupations. <a class="project-card-paper-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15265">Read the paper&nbsp;&rarr;</a></p>

        </a>
        <p class="project-card-desc">ChatGPT&#x27;s release sharply cut demand for substitutable freelance skills like writing and translation, while some complementary skills grew. <a class="project-card-paper-link" href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167268124004591">Read the paper&nbsp;&rarr;</a></p>
